name: University of Arizona
tests: English minimums: TOEFL iBT 79 (pre-Jan 2026) or 4 (new scale), IELTS Academic 6.5, Duolingo 110, Cambridge 180/C1, PTE etc.; SAT EBRW 580 or ACT English 21 also accepted.

name: Rutgers University–New Brunswick
tests: SAT/ACT optional for most programmes. English proficiency required if schooling was outside an English-speaking country: TOEFL iBT 79 (tests to 21 Jan 2026) or 4.5 on the new scale; IELTS 6.5 (6.0 for some schools); MET 56; or SAT EBRW 550 / ACT English; Duolingo also accepted. Waivers possible for English-medium schools.
gpa_note: Holistic academic review; competitive schools (engineering, business, pharmacy) expect strong maths and science grades.

name: University of Leicester
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general. English: every degree page specifies a minimum IELTS score; other tests and qualifications are accepted at equivalent levels (tests must be under two years old at course start). Medicine requires the UCAT.
gpa_note: Typical offers around AAB–BBB at A-level depending on the course; medicine is higher.

name: Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech)
tests: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/
gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

name: North Carolina State University (NC State)
tests: Official English proficiency scores (TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or PTE) must be sent directly by the testing agency; ACT reading 27+ or SAT reading 33+ subscore can also satisfy it. See NC State's test-score page for how SAT/ACT/CLT are considered.

name: Swansea University
tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: e.g. Economics IELTS 6.0 with at least 5.5 in each component.

name: York University
tests: SAT/ACT not required. English proficiency required for applicants whose first language is not English (see York international requirements).

name: Heriot-Watt University
tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English requirements are listed on Heriot-Watt’s English language pages.
gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. MA Economics: BBC (minimum BCC) at A-level, or IB 29.

name: Case Western Reserve University
tests: Test-optional (40% of students enrolled without tests). English minimums for non-native speakers: Duolingo 115, IELTS 7, PTE 61, TOEFL iBT 90 (before 21 Jan 2026) / 4.5 (from 21 Jan 2026); SAT EBRW 630+ or ACT English 26+ also accepted.

name: Rutgers University-New Brunswick
tests: English minimums (New Brunswick): TOEFL iBT 79 (to 21 Jan 2026) or 4.5 (from 22 Jan 2026), IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, PTE 53, MET 56, Cambridge B2, SAT EBRW 550 or ACT English 21. Pharmacy and Nursing require higher scores (e.g. TOEFL 100 / 5.5).

name: Tufts University
tests: Test-optional (about half of applicants submit). Enrolled mid-50%: SAT EBRW 730-770, SAT Math 740-790, ACT 33-35. English: no minimums, but successful applicants typically have TOEFL iBT 100+ (or 5.0+ new scale), IELTS 7+, PTE 68+, Duolingo 130+.
gpa_note: Enrolled mid-50%: SAT EBRW 730-770, Math 740-790, ACT 33-35.

name: Brunel University of London
tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: IELTS 6.5 with at least 5.5 in each area, Pearson 59, TOEFL 4.5 (new scale) with 4 in each sub-score, or BrunELT.
gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. Economics: ABB (contextual BBB) or IB 31 (contextual 30), as listed for the latest cycle.

name: Sciences Po
tests: No SAT/ACT. Applicants can choose English-taught, French-taught or bilingual tracks; English tracks require proof of English (typically C1 level, e.g. IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 100). Shortlisted applicants have an oral interview.

name: Virginia Tech (Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University)
tests: English: TOEFL iBT 80 (no subsection below 16) or 4.5 on the new scale (no subsection below 4.0), IELTS 6.5 (no sub-score below 6.5), Duolingo 115, PTE 59, Cambridge 176; SAT EBRW 550 or ACT English 24 also accepted.

name: Indiana University Bloomington
tests: Test-optional admission. English minimums: TOEFL iBT 79, IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, Cambridge English 176, PTE and others listed on IU's English proficiency page.

name: University of Illinois Chicago (UIC)
tests: English minimums: TOEFL iBT 80 or 4.5 (new scale), IELTS Academic 6.5, PTE 54, Duolingo 120 (accepted from fall 2027).

name: University of Victoria
tests: SAT/ACT not required. English proficiency required for applicants whose first language is not English (see UVic international page).

name: Northeastern University
tests: Test-optional. Non-native English speakers should submit TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or similar; competitive scores are around TOEFL 100 (old scale), IELTS 7.0+, Duolingo 125+ (verify).

name: The American University in Cairo (AUC)
tests: SAT/ACT may be requested for some curricula (e.g., American diploma). English: TOEFL / IELTS / AUC English test.

name: Ajman University
tests: English-taught programmes: 80% in Grade 12 English, or IELTS Academic 5.0 / TOEFL iBT 61 (ITP 500). Doctor of Medicine: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 79. Subject minimums: 90% in maths and two sciences for medicine and dentistry; 80% for engineering and pharmacy; 70-75% maths for IT, AI, law and IS.

name: University of California, Riverside (UC Riverside)
tests: Test-blind: SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. English (if required): IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before Jan 2026) / 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale (from Jan 2026). Some majors or campuses may expect more.

name: University at Buffalo (SUNY)
tests: International applicants must show English proficiency (see UB international application page).

name: Oxford Brookes University
tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: Brookes’ standard English language requirements (see university page); pre-sessional English available.
gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. Economics: ABB or IB 32 (contextual BCC / IB 29).

name: Bilkent University
tests: Minimum qualifications include SAT (digital or paper) 1000/1600, or accepted A-level, IB and national diplomas; English proficiency proof or Bilkent’s English preparatory programme.
gpa_note: Minimums such as SAT 1000/1600 or three A-levels at grade C+ in relevant subjects; scholarships based on grades and exam scores.

name: University of California, Santa Cruz (UC Santa Cruz)
tests: Test-blind: SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. English (if required): IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before Jan 2026) / 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale (from Jan 2026). Some majors or campuses may expect more.
gpa_note: Middle 50% high-school GPA of fall 2026 admits: 3.79-4.20 (UC admit data).

name: Stony Brook University (SUNY)
tests: Test-optional. Fall 2025 first-years who submitted scores: SAT 1350-1470, ACT 30-34 (middle 50%). English proficiency via official TOEFL, Duolingo, IELTS, PTE Academic, SAT, ACT, AP, IB or A-Level results.
gpa_note: Fall 2025 first-year middle 50%: high-school GPA 3.7-4.0 (92-98 on a 100 scale).

name: Prince Sultan University
tests: All high-school entrants start in a one-year Preparatory Year Program. English minimum for the PYP: Qiyas English Placement Test 50, or TOEFL iBT 25 (old scale) / 2 (new 1-6 scale), or equivalents. Qudrat or SAT scores are not mandatory but strongly recommended for shortlisting.

name: King Khalid University
tests: English-taught colleges require IELTS 5.0 or equivalent. International curricula accepted with Saudi equivalency: SAT I 1000/1600 or ACT 22/36 for US-system graduates; IGCSE/AS-level or IB HL subjects matched to the programme (biology and chemistry for health, maths and physics for science/engineering).

name: Al Ain University
tests: English: 80% in high-school English, or IELTS 5.0, or TOEFL 500; otherwise a 3-credit remedial English course. Subject minimums apply for pharmacy, engineering and law (remedial courses possible).

name: Zayed University
tests: Programme-specific: e.g. 80% in Grade 12 English or TOEFL iBT 72 and 80% maths or SAT Math 530 for business/IT; 85% English or TOEFL iBT 79 and SAT Math 590 for more technical majors. TOEFL Home Edition not accepted.
